{{Wireless adapter |brand=Zonet |model=ZEW2500P |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date= |manuf_country= |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Female Mini-B |form_factor=corded (modular) adapter |vendor_id=148f |device_id=2573 |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=PQP-WU233G |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Ralink |chip1_model=RT2571W |chip2_brand=Ralink |chip2_model=RT2526 |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui=00:06:F4, 00:FD:07, 00:A1:B0 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} RT73 chipset
The FCC submission photos show the device with an RT2572, however, the device actually has an RT2571W
These devices appear to have varying revisions and (very likely) varying manufacturers. *unknown sub-model with 00:06:F4 OUI ('''PESI''') [http://www.monkey.org/openbsd/archive2/misc/200605/msg00303.html] :<small>'''ural0: MAC/BBP RT2570 (rev 0x05), RF RT2526, address 00:06:f4:0c:7e:4a'''</small> *two devices with ZEW2500P/91-007-00130 models had 00:FD:07 OUIs (likely a primarily '''Zowee''' used OUI) *two devices with ZEW2500P/91-007-00174 model has an OUI of 00:A1:B0 (B-LINK) *one device with ZEW2500P/91-007-00184 model has an OUI of 00:A1:B0 (B-LINK) and the (nearly bare) PCB has a RT3070 (or RT2070, not confirmed) and the characteristic B-LINK text
[http://forums.freebsd.org/showthread.php?t=7562&page=5 another reference to a RT3070 based ZEW2500P on the FreeBSD forums], 00:A1:B0 OUI
